manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain active.
manifest.description: A side-by-side view of a tossed ball on a vertical height ruler and its velocity-time graph, demonstrating that gravity continues to accelerate the ball even when it momentarily stops at the apex.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
